description: Payment requests stored in a NimBooks backup file (the app keeps them on the device; there is no server holding them). Requires the server to be started with --backup <path>. Read-only: the file is never written to, and the cashlink shelf inside it — which holds link private keys — is never opened.

address.description: The account whose requests to list. Optional; defaults to the server’s configured address.

name: list_invoices
title: List saved payment requests
